summary: Implemented orchestrator/grouping/plan_edit.py as the single verbatim-surgery module: extract_task_map_entries/render_task_map_block for byte-exact task-map entry slicing, split_units for byte-exact unit-section slicing, validate_plan for structural consistency checks, and verify_map_unchanged which diffs two plan documents' surviving task entries (field-level, via YAML) and unit ids, reporting every difference found. Added task_map_block_span to plan_reader.py and locate_units_span/UNIT_HEADING to plan_sections.py as the minimal span helpers plan_edit needed, reusing the existing fence/heading regexes rather than duplicating them. Wired `orchestrate plan-check <plan> [--against <path>]` into cli.py, dispatching before any config/LLM/codegraph setup. All 5 verification items pass, confirmed live against the repo's real 36-unit plan (byte-identical round trip, ~0.8ms per validate_plan call). Full suite is green except 5 pre-existing, unrelated failures traced to sandbox environment issues (cross-device git worktree move, permission-denied mkdir under ~/.claude/projects) that reproduce with zero relation to this diff.
